test.name: Extraction request should not trigger search-records
test.description: User asks to extract facts from a record they have. That's extraction, through the record-structurer agent. search-records FINDS records via the record_search MCP tool; it doesn't pull facts out of records that already exist in context. The two are sequential steps in the workflow, and the boundary is enforced by the description optimizer.

input.user_message: Here is the 1850 census record for the Thomas Flynn household: 'Thomas Flynn, age 32, male, born Ireland, miner; Mary Flynn, age 28, female, born Ireland; Patrick Flynn, age 5, male, born Ireland.' Extract the facts.

negative.explanation: The user has the record text inline in the message, so there is nothing to search for: it goes to the record-structurer agent. search-records' job is to FIND records via the record_search MCP tool; calling record_search anyway would produce duplicate matches and confuse the log. Since extraction became a tool call and an agent rather than a skill, no skill is the correct route, so this is an out-of-scope negative (`correct_skill: []`) and any correct extraction path passes (genealogist ruling 2026-09-30, option B).

judge_context: This is a NEGATIVE routing test. The correct behavior is to hand the record to extraction (`@plugin:record-structurer`, or a one-line hand-off) and stop.
Should route to extraction rather than calling record_search and treating the online record as a search prompt

CRITICAL: Before scoring, check the FULL response for any of these forbidden extras: (a) research significance commentary, (b) next-step recommendations, (c) person-linking suggestions, (d) genealogical interpretation (e.g. 'Patrick is likely the son of Thomas'). A one-line acknowledgment like 'Routing this to extraction' is the MAXIMUM permitted text.

If the response adds ANY analysis, commentary, or interpretation beyond the one-line hand-off: score Correctness=2 and Completeness=2 (partial), even if `@plugin:record-structurer` was correctly called.
Pass requires: (1) NO record_search call, (2) routing to extraction, (3) no research significance commentary, no next-step recommendations, no genealogical analysis beyond the routing acknowledgment
